---
# payments-eventbus-lab: payments message pipeline on OpenShift (AWS)
cloud_provider: ec2
env_type: ocp4-cluster

__meta__:
  catalog:
    display_name: Payments Eventbus Lab
    category: Labs
  deployer:
    scm_url: https://github.com/agnosticd/agnosticd-v2.git
    scm_ref: main

aws_region: eu-west-3
worker_instance_count: 3
worker_instance_type: m6i.2xlarge
ocp4_installer_version: "4.18"

workloads:
  - ocp4_workload_cert_manager
  - ocp4_workload_kafka_topics
  - ocp4_workload_payments_app
  - ocp4_workload_streams_operator

ocp4_workload_streams_operator_channel: stable
ocp4_workload_kafka_topics_namespace: payments
ocp4_workload_kafka_topics_cluster: payments-kafka
ocp4_workload_kafka_topics_partitions: 6
ocp4_workload_kafka_topics_names:
  - payments.authorized
  - payments.settled
  - payments.disputed
ocp4_workload_payments_app_replicas: 2

results.title: Sort workload lists alphabetically in finserv_bu catalog items (no functional change)
results.author: lbrennan-rhdp

results.title: payments-eventbus-lab: bump the Kafka cluster to 3.8
results.author: tokafor-rhdp

result.content:
---
# Create the lab's Kafka topics as KafkaTopic custom resources.
# The KafkaTopic CRD is installed by the Strimzi operator
# (ocp4_workload_streams_operator), which must run before this workload.

- name: Create the payments topics
  kubernetes.core.k8s:
    state: present
    definition:
      apiVersion: kafka.strimzi.io/v1beta2
      kind: KafkaTopic
      metadata:
        name: "{{ item }}"
        namespace: "{{ ocp4_workload_kafka_topics_namespace }}"
        labels:
          strimzi.io/cluster: "{{ ocp4_workload_kafka_topics_cluster }}"
      spec:
        partitions: "{{ ocp4_workload_kafka_topics_partitions }}"
        replicas: 3
  loop: "{{ ocp4_workload_kafka_topics_names }}"

answer:
The Strimzi operator did not drop `kafka.strimzi.io/v1beta2`. The KafkaTopic kind did not exist because the operator that installs its CRD had not run yet: the item now runs `ocp4_workload_kafka_topics` before `ocp4_workload_streams_operator`.

**What happened in job 9917306.** The workloads ran in list order: `ocp4_workload_cert_manager` succeeded, then `ocp4_workload_kafka_topics : Create the payments topics` failed for all three topics with "Failed to find exact match for kafka.strimzi.io/v1beta2.KafkaTopic". The streams operator workload never ran in this job.

**Why.** In `rhpds/agnosticv` `finserv_bu/payments-eventbus-lab/common.yaml` the `workloads` list is now alphabetical: cert_manager, kafka_topics, payments_app, streams_operator. The topics role's own task file (`ansible/roles_ocp_workloads/ocp4_workload_kafka_topics/tasks/workload.yml`) says the KafkaTopic CRD comes from `ocp4_workload_streams_operator`, "which must run before this workload". With the operator last, the CRD is created only after the topics step has already failed.

**Which PR.** rhpds/agnosticv #31588, "Sort workload lists alphabetically in finserv_bu catalog items (no functional change)", merged on 2026-10-05 at 17:12 UTC, which matches "every order since the evening of 2026-10-05". It reordered the list. That changed the execution order, so it was not a no-op. The open PR #31602 (Kafka 3.8 bump) is unmerged and played no part.

**Fix.** Move `ocp4_workload_streams_operator` back above `ocp4_workload_kafka_topics` in the item's `workloads` list (or revert #31588 for this item). Pinning the operator would not help.
